summary: Retest of the iteration_2 issues. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed, including 3 new tests. nome '   ' gives 422 on POST and on PUT, and '  TEST_Strip  ' is stored as 'TEST_Strip'. Flyer on mobile 390x844: the footer is now visible on screen and in the downloaded PNG (1215x2160). Endereço and Cidade are in one row. The obs box fills the remaining space (107px) and has a solid border on all 4 sides. Field padding-bottom is 5px. Obs maxLength is 200: filling 300 chars kept 200. Pre-fill is correct: nome, tel, end, cidade 'Bicas - MG', data 28/10/2026, hora, servico, taxa R$ 80,00, and obs = default text + ag.obs. Editing the nome and toggling Cooktop are reflected in the PNG. The send fallback opens api.whatsapp.com with phone 5532999991111 and the emoji text. Agenda create/edit/concluir/delete works on mobile. No page errors. New issue found: the sonner toast covers the flyer close button for a few seconds after download or send.

ui_bugs.issue: After flyer-download-btn or flyer-send-btn, the top 'Imagem salva...' toast covers the modal header. elementFromPoint at the close button returns the toast <li>, so tapping X (even with force) does not close the modal until the toast is dismissed. Fix: put the Toaster at bottom-center, or give it an offset or a lower z-index than the modal header while the flyer is open.

maxLength 200 does not limit line breaks. 8 short lines give scrollHeight 152 vs clientHeight 107, so they are clipped in the PNG with no warning. Consider limiting the number of lines (for example 6) or auto-shrinking the font.
The Footer bottom is at 721px vs the canvas at 720px, so 1px of footer padding is clipped. Not visible. Cosmetic only.

issues: Header and Soluções icons and the tipo checkboxes still sit slightly above their text baseline in the PNG (small issue, already known).

action_items: Stop the Sonner toast from covering flyer-close-btn on mobile (move the toast position or offset it)
Optional: limit the number of obs lines so the PNG is never clipped
critical_code_review_comments: enviar(): window.open after await html2canvas may be popup-blocked on real mobile browsers in the non-share fallback (low risk, already known).
